description: §8.1.2 (S456 fix round F2/F4) — an unbackticked `?{ … }` holding two statements in an `if` condition. The expression parser leaves the condition as unparsed text, and codegen's text path lowers only the backtick form `?{`…`}`; on main d2bc3a065 it was emitted unrewritten (invalid JavaScript) with no diagnostic. A `?{` in a position no check can read is refused at compile.
rationale: §8.1.2: a `?{}` in expression text the compiler holds unparsed that the compiler does not lower (no backtick template, a backtick inside the body, or no `}` right after the closing backtick) is E-SQL-QUERY-NOT-READABLE — fail closed at compile, never a runtime-only failure.
